chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Her mother, step-father and half brother
summary: Her mother lived until 1959; her stepfather William White; her brother uses the Williams or French name.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay. Alright now, to bring the story forward a little bit perhaps, could you tell us something about the history of your mother? What happened to her? How long she lived.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yeah, well my mother lived up until 1959, I believe, because in 1944 she had a stroke and she was still in Homestead. And during that time I got the house that I live in now, and after a few years, after I got settled, I sent for her and she came to live with me up until she passed, she lived with me about --she lived to be sixty-five years old.
Okay, and the step-father that you mentioned. You gave us the surname White, I believe.
Yeah.
I don't think you gave us a first name for him.
I think his name was William. I didn't know too much about him.
Do you know what happened to him?
I have no idea.
Okay, and you also mentioned a half brother that you had.
Yes, Paul.
His name was Paul French?
Yes.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
How about him?
He uses the name of Paul French. He uses the family name. He lives in Braddock, Pennsylvania. In fact . . .
TAPE # 8 SIDE B

He still has friends and connections in Homestead, Pennsylvania. In fact, just last month when I was away I went to Homestead to celebrate the 100th anniversary, and as part of the celebration he promoted a jazz party at one of the clubs there. I went. The celebration of course, the big celebration, the banquet was held in Munhall, Pennsylvania, which is a little adjacent borough. It seems that since I left they - there has been a merger of three independent boroughs, Munhall, Homestead and I guess Mifflin Township. So they are all part of Homestead now. And so the banquet was held there. I was invited to the banquet and I received a certificate of recognition from the committee there. But the next night Paul had his little celebration in Homestead because I don't believe that a lot of people got to the banquet. So a lot of the people I knew, alot of my friends showed up at the

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

party he had. It was like a reunion. I had a really good time. And Paul had a very good combination of musicians. There's a musician around Pittsburgh, I suppose, by the name of Gene Ludwig who has a four-piece combination. They were very good. And I sang with them and they were very good.
